subject: with *.Rmd/KnitHTML - ggvis plot doesn't show in viewer or browser

messages.author: 068bc505d23a7e77
messages.subject: with *.Rmd/KnitHTML - ggvis plot doesn't show in viewer or browser
parts:
Hi, all.

I'm beginning to experiment with ggvis.  For some reason, when simply sending chunks of code, I have no problem getting a plot to show in RStudio's viewer.  But, if I include the code in an *.Rmd file and KnitHTML, everything but the plot shows (both in the RStudio viewer and in browser (Chrome)).  Any suggestions?  Thanks in advance.

System/software:  Windows 7 (32-bit), R-3.0.2, RStudio 0.98.501

--Trey



test2
=========

```{r}
set.seed(20)
var1 <- rnorm(100, 20, 3)
var2 <- var1/2
vars <- data.frame(var1,var2)
```

```{r results='asis'}
library(ggvis)
qvis(vars, ~var1, ~var2)
```

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: with *.Rmd/KnitHTML - ggvis plot doesn't show in viewer or browser
parts:
If I am correct, the feature to embed ggvis visualizations in R Markdown was added in a later version of RStudio. Try to download the latest daily build.

Secondly, you will need to add YAML front matter to the document. It uses a custom output formatter that is NOT exported by ggvis, and so can expect to change. So use with caution. 

---
output:
  ggvis:::html_document
---

Thanks so much, Ramnath.

Didn't need an updated version of RStudio.  Just added the YAML front matter to the *.Rmd, like you suggested.  Then, used the render() function after loading the rmarkdown package.  Worked like a charm.  Thanks, again.

Best,
